info.title: nadel builds the stories and assets of Faden games.
info.description: nadel, the command line tool of the Faden visual novel engine: it checks, generates, packs and builds a game.

commands.name: build
commands.description:
Updates the text lock and the catalogs, checks the story and packs it when the check finds no
error, taking the scripts, assets, declarations, locales and key from a game project or from
the options that pack takes.
--project <file or directory>  A game project, or a folder of scripts with an assets folder.
--entry <node>                 A node the game starts at. Repeatable, start by default.
--output <file>                The pack file to write.
It also takes every option of pack, while those given by --project cannot be given again.

commands.name: catalogs
commands.description:
Updates the text lock, the template and the catalogs after the scripts changed.
--scripts <file or directory>  A script, or a directory searched for .faden files. Repeatable.
--locales <directory>          The directory the lock, the template and the catalogs are kept in.
--languages <tags>             Languages to start catalogs for, such as de,ja.
--declarations <file or dir>   The C# files declaring the world state and the commands.

commands.name: check
commands.description:
Looks for mistakes that compile but break the story: nodes no path reaches, missing images,
requirements that never hold, speakers without cast and broken translations.
--scripts <file or directory>  A script, or a directory searched for .faden files. Repeatable.
--assets <directory>           A directory of assets, to check the stage images. Repeatable.
--locales <directory>          The directory holding lines.lock.json and the .po catalogs.
--declarations <file or dir>   The C# files declaring the world state and the commands.
--entry <node>                 A node the game starts at. Repeatable, start by default.

commands.name: generate
commands.description:
Writes the generated part of the world state and the commands a game declares in C#,
and the names of its assets.
--declarations <file or dir>   The C# files declaring them. Repeatable.
--assets <directory>           An asset directory whose assets get names. Repeatable.
--namespace <name>             The namespace of the asset names.
--output <file>                The C# file to write.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Starts a new game project: its project file, a first script, the folders of its assets and a
program that plays it.
--name <name>                  The name of the project, by default the name of the folder.
--output <directory>           Where it is written, by default here.
--kind <kind>                  novel, which is the default, or sandbox.
--version <version>            The version of the Faden packages it references.
--engine <directory>           A Faden repository to reference instead of the packages.

commands.name: key
commands.description:
Writes a new random key for encrypted packs.
--output <file>                The key file to write.

commands.name: lsp
commands.description:
Runs the language server an editor talks to, over the input and the output of the process.
It answers with the mistakes of a story, completion, hover, go to definition, references,
symbols and colours, reading the scripts, the assets and the C# declarations of a project.
--stdio                        Names the transport, which some editors pass.

commands.name: pack
commands.description:
Compiles the scripts and translations, encodes images for the graphics card and audio with
ffmpeg when it is installed, and packs everything with the assets into one file.
--scripts <file or directory>  A script, or a directory searched for .faden files. Repeatable.
--assets <directory>           A directory of assets. Repeatable.
--locales <directory>          The directory holding lines.lock.json and the .po catalogs.
--declarations <file or dir>   The C# files declaring the world state and the commands.
--output <file>                The pack file to write.
--key <file>                   A key written by nadel key, to encrypt the pack with.
--compression <level>          none, fastest, optimal or smallest, which is the default.
--cache <directory>            Where encoded images and audio are kept between builds.
--textures <format>            bc7 for desktops, which is the default, astc for phones,
which needs astcenc, or none to pack images as they are.
